Mentra by SATS tests new product concept quickly with Commerce Layer

Mentra by SATS, an entrepreneurial business unit within SATS, wanted to quickly test a new digital home training concept to complement its physical gyms. To move fast and avoid dependencies on third-party consultants, the team chose Commerce Layer as the commerce engine for a composable commerce setup, alongside Contentful for headless content management.

Commerce Layer helped Mentra launch the concept in-market with full autonomy over branding and implementation, enabling the team to go from project start to orders placed successfully in just 2 months. The direct Slack support and fast responses from Commerce Layer’s CTO and team also helped Mentra test, learn, and refine the offer quickly, with successful elements later brought back into SATS.
